401921670.summary: Every source read backs unbeaten USC (6-0) over unbeaten South Carolina (5-0) in a neutral-site game at Acrisure Arena in Palm Springs. Bang The Book takes USC on the moneyline (-600), Pick Dawgz takes USC against the spread, and the CappersPicks AI model projects USC by 22 (88-66). The reasons: USC scores 94.2 a game on 52% shooting, ranks 31st/20th in adjusted offense/defense against South Carolina's 89th/95th, and is 9th in defensive eFG%; South Carolina has not yet played away from home. Alijah Arenas (21.3) and Rodney Rice lead USC; Juan Fernandez (15.2) leads South Carolina. CappersPicks lists USC center Eric Reibe out (foot); Bang The Book's status check showed none.

picks.note: Higher scoring and assist averages; already won away from home

picks.bet: USC -8.5 (article's pick; its odds table shows -11.5)
picks.note: Top-35 offense and defense; a step up in class for South Carolina

fav.note: C, foot (CappersPicks injury table, no date given)

dog.note: G, lower leg (CappersPicks, no date given)

401924705.summary: Both sources read expect Columbia (5-1, first in the early Ivy table) to beat winless Saint Peter's (0-6) at home. Bang The Book takes Columbia on the moneyline at -1450, citing its shooting (47%, 83.0 points a game) and passing (17.3 assists); Saint Peter's averages 48.8 points on 31% shooting. Columbia has won five straight, including 75-53 over Northwestern. Scores24 also picks Columbia to win, but its editorial bet is Saint Peter's +15.5, noting the Peacocks covered +15.5 in 14 of their last 16 road games. Leaders: Gerard O'Keefe (16.5) for Columbia, Bryce Eaton (13.0) for Saint Peter's. No injuries reported.

picks.note: Stronger shooting and passing; Saint Peter's scores 48.8 a game

picks.bet: Columbia to win (1.08); editorial bet Saint Peter's +15.5 (-110)
picks.note: Peacocks covered +15.5 in 14 of last 16 road games

injuries.note: None reported: Bang The Book's status check (Nov 25 01:00 UTC) returned no player statuses; Scores24 has no injury section.

401920858.summary: Previews are thin: no source read gives a moneyline pick or a predicted score. Both teams are 2-4; Marshall lost to Ohio State, Toledo, Youngstown State and North Carolina, while Prairie View has lost four straight. The iHeart preview takes Prairie View +16.5 against the spread without a reason; its numbers show Prairie View allowing 82.7 points (331st) and 48.4% shooting (338th), while Marshall shoots 42.7% (279th). Covers trends note Prairie View covered in 14 of its last 16 road games and Marshall in only 5 of its last 18 home games. Scores24 only makes first-half and total picks (Marshall first half, Over 151.5). Noah Otshudi (20.2) leads Marshall. No injuries reported.

injuries.note: None reported in the sources read (iHeart, Scores24, Covers, RotoWire).
